segs.t: Privacy Policy
Effective date:
November 6, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how SSOL Astro House handles your personal information. Our Birth Details Consent, Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Terms of Use, Disclaimer and Refund Policy are published as separate pages.
Who we are
SSOL Astro House (the "Service") is run by SSOL Wellness House ("SSOL", "we", "us"), based in the Republic of Korea. We decide how your personal information is used, so we are the data controller.

rows: Room 408, 4F, 100 Dongmak-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

segs.t: This policy covers the English version of the Service at astro.ssolwellnesshouse.com/en, including the star report and the link to Sowella AI. It follows Korea's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and, for visitors in those regions, the EU and UK GDPR and California privacy law.

SSOL Wellness House offers non-clinical wellness coaching and wellness sessions. We don't provide psychotherapy, diagnosis or medical treatment. Your readings are wellness content for self-understanding. Because your birth details and answers describe you personally, we handle them with the same care as sensitive information.
At a glance
Your birth details are used only for your chart.
We ask for your date, time and city of birth to calculate your birth chart, and use them for nothing else. You give separate, explicit consent first.
Your report is built from texts we wrote.
An AI model from OpenAI only checks its tone and flow. We only send OpenAI your nickname, your three answers and your chart details — never your date, time or place of birth.
No account needed.
You can save results and pay without signing in.
We never sell your data.
We share it only with the services that run the site, take payments and measure our ads.
Your data may leave Korea.
Some of those services are in the United States, and Sowella AI runs on servers in India. The section "Where your data goes" lists them.
You stay in control.
You can see, fix or delete your data, and withdraw consent, at any time.
This summary helps you read the policy. The full text below is what applies.

segs.t: Consent boxes.

Before your reading starts you see two required unticked boxes and one optional unticked box for cookies. The first confirms that you are 18 or older, agree to the Terms of Use and have read this Privacy Policy. The second is your separate, explicit consent: *"I agree that SSOL may use my date, time and place of birth and my answers to calculate my birth chart and create my results."* Next to it we show what we collect, why, and how long we keep it, with a link to the full Birth Details Consent. Without the second box we cannot give you a reading. You can withdraw it at any time; we then delete this information. The optional third box lets you allow analytics and ad-measurement cookies; leave it unticked and they stay off (see the Cookie Policy).
Legitimate interests.

Where we rely on legitimate interests, those interests are keeping the Service secure and free of abuse, understanding which channels bring visitors, and answering your messages. We weigh them against your rights, and you can object at any time (see "Your rights").
Birth details are used for your chart only.
We do not use them for statistics, ads or anything else.
Card details.
We never collect or store your card number, expiry date or CVC. Toss Payments and PayPal handle them on their own secure systems.
What we do not collect.
We do not ask for your phone number, home address or ID number.
How your report is made.

Your results and star report are put together automatically from rules and texts we wrote. For the paid star report, an AI model from OpenAI checks the tone and flow of the text. We only send OpenAI, L.L.C. (United States) your nickname, your answers to the three questions and your chart details (signs, houses and planet positions) — never your date, time or place of birth, your email or payment details. Your report is for entertainment and self-reflection and does not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on you.
Using your results in Sowella AI.
When you tap
Start a chat with Sowella AI

on your report, we pass the items in the table above to Sowella AI, which runs on servers in India, so it can greet you and tailor the chat. We do not pass your original birth date, time or place, or any payment details. Sowella AI writes its replies with models from OpenAI, L.L.C. (United States); we send OpenAI only these items and your chat messages, never your email or payment details. Under OpenAI's API terms, this data is not used to train its models. Anything you share about your health is covered by our Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy. Sowella AI has its own terms and privacy notice. You can remove the report summary it uses with

in Sowella AI, or by emailing contact@ssolwellness.com.
Who we share it with
We do not sell your personal information or give it to other companies for their own use, except:
when you have agreed to it separately;
when the law requires it, such as a request from investigators following the procedure set by law.

We use the service providers below to run the Service. They act on our behalf under contract, and we supervise how they protect your data. Several are in the United States, and Sowella AI runs on servers in India, so your data may be transferred to those countries.

segs.t: We never send your birth details, nickname, answers, email address or phone number to Google Analytics or X.

Data is sent over encrypted connections each time you use the Service, and providers keep it until our contract ends or as their own policies say. The EU and the UK recognize Korea as giving adequate data protection. For onward transfers to providers outside Korea, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or another lawful mechanism. You can refuse analytics and ad cookies; the other transfers are needed to provide the Service.
How long we keep it
We delete your data as soon as we no longer need it. Some records must be kept longer by Korean law.

segs.t: When the period ends, we erase electronic files so they cannot be recovered and shred any printed copies.
How we protect it
Management:
an internal privacy plan, as few staff with access as possible, regular training.
Technical:
access rights control, access control systems, encryption of personal information, security software kept up to date.
Physical:
restricted access to places where personal information is stored.
No system is completely secure. If a breach affects you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
Children

The English Service, including Sowella AI, is for adults aged 18 and over and may not be suitable for minors. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone younger. If we learn that we have, we stop their use and delete the data. If you think a minor has given us data, write to contact@ssolwellness.com.
Your rights
Wherever you live, you can:
see the personal information we hold about you and get a copy;
correct it if it is wrong;
delete it, or ask us to stop or limit using it;
withdraw any consent you gave, without affecting what we did before.

You can view and edit your information in your account, and withdraw all consent by deleting your account. For anything else, email contact@ssolwellness.com. We may ask you to confirm your identity first. We act without delay and reply within one month at the latest.
EU and UK residents
also have the right to data portability, to object to processing based on legitimate interests, and to complain to your local data protection authority.
California residents

also have the right to know what categories of data we collect, to opt out of "sharing" for cross-context behavioral advertising (our X ad measurement), and not to be treated differently for using these rights. Use the
Do Not Sell or Share
link in the footer or turn off advertising cookies. We honor Global Privacy Control signals.
Korean residents

can also contact the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, privacy.kisa.or.kr), the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr), the Supreme Prosecutors' Office (1301, www.spo.go.kr) or the Korean National Police Agency (182, ecrm.cyber.go.kr).
Changes to this policy

We post changes here at least 7 days before they take effect. Changes that seriously affect your rights, such as new data items or new recipients, are posted at least 30 days ahead, and we ask for new consent where the law requires.
Contact

Privacy officer: Junseok Kim, CEO, SSOL Wellness House, Room 408, 4F, 100 Dongmak-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. Email: contact@ssolwellness.com. Contact number: +82-10-2835-2263. We answer every privacy question without delay.
